detail: Whether the wand keeps a per-chat Crew permission row (the legacy Allow Crews in this chat) as a per-chat override of the project-wide Crew Auto default, and what it is called. Decision card p02 (E-02) of /mnt/Cursor/PuppetMaster-Evidence/scratch/pm56-modules-canon-20260927/cards.json, SHA-256 61bb8f6b19684c7ed0df1f6c92daf3e0ee94b6b07fd4c7e8f9b70c9717caa37a; answer record p02 in /mnt/Cursor/PuppetMaster-Evidence/scratch/pm56-modules-canon-20260927/ANSWERS.json, SHA-256 4f8d3b25857faab5237b33f80d116b421fd75e81a89c233aaed19dcd8ecb844f; recorded as DL-120. raised_by: WAIT wave of group G5 (owner answer needs follow-up)
answered_by: DL-120 (the design lead's ruling of 2026-09-27, recorded in both Decision Log sections)
disposition: Answered and compiled: the lead ruled on 2026-09-27 (recorded in DL-120, both sections) that Crew Auto is the assistant's permission to start a Crew by itself, on by default at project level, that a chat's Crew Auto check overrides the project default for that chat, that the CWR-021 evaluator remains the gate, that Build With Crew stays the user's choice, and that the separate per-chat Allow Crews in this chat switch is retired into the Crew Auto check. Compiled as F3-578 (the check is the chat's only Crew permission control; checking it sends cmd.chat.crew_auto.set with scope thread, commits before the check changes and never opens the sheet), F3-531's amendment line, FinalGUISpec section 3 and the v4 MODAL paragraph, and the ACD v4 wand-contents paragraph, following Collaborative_Workflows CWR-004, CWR-021 and CWR-038. The project default being on is a Settings change, out of this compile.

disposition: Answered and compiled: the lead ruled on 2026-09-27 (recorded in DL-116, both sections) that a rule counts as followed when it was given to the assistant and the finished reply passed that rule's check, that a failed check shows Missed 1 of your rules with a way to see which and ask for a fix, and that no tick shows when no check could run; assistant-memory-subsystem AMS-053 defines following. Compiled as ACD-477 (the reply's rule note and its three cases), F3-570 (the inclusion tick replaced by the rule note, 40 px budget kept), F3-579 (points to F3-570) and FinalGUISpec section 5. Which command carries the Missed note's ask-for-a-fix request is the command catalog's to name (ledger pldg-20260927-004 q-007); this ledger names none.
